review:
Johnny Cash robs a speeding train on a cluster grid. Winning clusters explode, the reels reflow, and wins turn into highlighted cells that feed a mini Coin Respin right in the base game.

Coin multipliers can hit 500x, with TNT setting off Coin Boosters and Collect Coins. There are three free spins modes – Free Spins (8), Super Free Spins (12, with cells that stay active) and Mega Free Spins, which only trigger naturally. Very high volatility, 10,000x max, 97% RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 300 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
